title: Copy shader fields into the project

fields.description: Comma-separated field slugs (aurora, caustics, cyber, flow, grid, nebula, warp, waves), or "all".

project.description: The application project to copy into. Defaults to the first application in angular.json.

force.description: Overwrite fields that already exist in the project.

list.description: Print the available fields and exit without copying anything.
